sourceSentences: [0] His hook stops on the first enemy hit.
[0] Braum's shield just blocks it, and the rest of them close the distance before his hook comes back up.
[0] Nautilus is an engaged support, and he loses to almost every other engaged support.
[1] Her root can go through minions whilst your hook can't which is very annoying. She also has good poke. If you can land a hook on her she should die very fast.
[1] Engage on her when she misses her Q and you will be favored.
[1] Once you bait her Q it's a free kill (or flash). Try avoiding getting poked by her undodgeable ability.
[1] Engage when her Q is on cooldown. Just all in her, because shes squishy.
[1] Can easily and safely poke nautilus without easy punishment, while protecting her adc from a distance with her shield.

[1] Nautilus n'est pas très mobile alors certains mages auront beaucoup de faciliter à te poke, donc il faut essayer de prendre le moins de dégâts possible pour pouvoir répondre rapidement lors d'un gank
[1] Like morgana, her Q is enough to cancel your whole engage and she's most likely to keep poking you with E, even if the ADC does bad, she still has massive carry potential.
[1] Luckily, unlike Morgana, she has no spellshield or escape mechanism. If you manage to get on her, she's likely dead. Exploit her low mobility by either engaging in lane with your ult, or roaming.
[1] Annoying poke but easy kill. Immoble mages are easy to deal if you outsustain their damage.
[1] Every hook you hit on her is an instant oneshot though. Dodge her Q and blow her up.

[2] I put Nautilus here because if he does land a hook, and you're far away from tower its most likely going to be a kill for the enemy team. If you play proactive with brush vision and leverage minions he is pretty easy to mitigate.
[2] His hook hitbox is comical... and has point and click kill with his kinda high range ult.
[2] Abuse their hook CDs, and their melee range, stay behind minions, and be inconsistent with your movement!

[2] Hook champions are deadly for Lux, even through the use of aftershock, if she misses a binding, or they're already in melee range of her and manage to get their cc off, she can be bursted down easily.
[2] Really easy. Just stay behind minions and POKE HIM LIKE HELL. Poke him so he can't even think about hooking you. Stay behind minions, and ward bushes.
[2] Ward and keep waves away from your tower to avoid dives. Stand in your wave and poke pre 6.
[2] It's annoying if he hit his hook. If you can dodge his hook, you can poke him really hard. After lvl 6 play safe because he has a garanteed cc with his ult. If his adc follows well, you're dead.
[2] Once he gets six he has a ton of engage with his ult and can easily ult you and then CC you after it knocks you up.
[2] However you can try to hide behind your minions to avoid hooks, and he can't ult to start engages like Leona. The best thing to do is try to hide behind minions and be mindful of a flash R.
[2] If you are hooked, you will die. Is also really tanky and does surprising damage.

[2] Nautilus has high damage. Respect his hook and his ULT. Being to far forward is the only way you lose this matchup. Try and abuse Nautilus early, playing inside the minion wave so he can't hook you
